system.description:
This skill only produces an effect when you have at least two empty [Accessory Slots]. You may maintain the effects of up to three [Enchantment] skills instead of only two.

(SR2): You need only one or more empty [Accessory Slots] for this skill to produce an effect.

A combat style in which support magic is applied to hand-made talismans, rings, etc. and maintained. This allows you to maintain more spells at once than normal.
